subject: Parking Permit Issued - $permit_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your parking permit has been successfully issued!

Permit Details:
- Permit ID: $permit_id
- Zone: $zone ($zone_description)
- Permit Type: $permit_type
- Valid From: $start_date
- Valid Until: $end_date
- Vehicle: $vehicle_info
- Status: $status

Important Information:
1. Display your permit visibly in your vehicle at all times when parked on campus
2. Park only in your designated zone ($zone)
3. Your permit is non-transferable
4. Report lost or stolen permits immediately

Parking Regulations:
- Observe all posted signage
- Do not park in handicap spaces without proper authorization
- Avoid fire lanes and restricted areas
- Follow speed limits (15 mph on campus)

To download your digital permit or for more information, visit:
https://university.edu/parking/permits

Questions? Contact Parking Services:
Phone: (555) 123-4567
Email: parking@university.edu
Office: Student Services Building, Room 120

$signature
